Remark
[Gromov--Hausdorff metric properties] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0415 1. appG:G.9\group Gromov–Hausdorff convergence The Gromov--Hausdorff distance is nonnegative, symmetric, and satisfies the triangle inequality; distance zero between compact spaces is equivalent to isometry.
